messages:
Priya R: Heads-up: Asterion private deployment tentative cutover set for Thu 07:30 PDT. Need final sign-off for networking, IAM cross-account roles, CMK policy, and audit ingestion. Owners: @Jordan L (network), @Samir D (infra), @Iris K (security), @Zoe M (CS lead).
Jordan L: Network short: TGW attachment live, spoke VPCs created. Customer provided CIDR 10.32.0.0/16. Routing PR: https://git.internal/net/PR-4982. Reminder: VPC flow logs are enabled but bucket s3://asterion-logs blocks PutObject from our logging account. I'll drop the bucket-policy diff in the PR.
Samir D: Infra items: created cross-account role arn:aws:iam::333344445555:role/Redwood-Asterion-CrossRole. Will provision VPC endpoints for S3 and KMS before cutover window. Creating CMK with rotation enabled and alias alias/asterion-cmk. Example IAM assume command for testing: ```bash
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::333344445555:role/Redwood-Asterion-CrossRole --role-session-name test
```
Iris K: Security: drafted KMS key policy requiring the cross-account principal and our service principal. Also proposing CloudTrail -> S3 (multi-region) with lifecycle 90d; forwarding into their SIEM via Kinesis Firehose. Ticket CS-4307 has the policy draft. Legal OK on 90d for now, but flagged in renewal notes.
Zoe M: CS note: captured customer preference for SQS notifications to their ingestion pipeline (simpler for their team). We'll present both options (SQS vs Firehose) in the pre-cutover call and capture selection in the ticket. Also logging ownership must be confirmed by EOD Tue or we hold the cutover.
Priya R: Risk callout: if they request EU-only storage or >90d retention during contract review, that becomes a renewal negotiation and possible delay. Mark as medium renewal risk.
Jordan L: Cost ops: NAT gateway egress could spike during image pulls. Plan: pre-pull images into internal cache and scope NAT rules to only the deployment subnets for a 3-hr window. I'll include estimated $ delta in the PR.
Samir D: Preflight tests scheduled Wed 16:00 PDT: canary deploy into reserved pool, KMS encrypt/decrypt via cross-account role, S3 write test to flow bucket. Preflight cmds: ```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.redwood.internal/health
aws s3 cp /tmp/test.log s3://asterion-logs/ --profile asterion-staging
aws kms encrypt --key-id alias/asterion-cmk --plaintext "test" --profile asterion-staging
```
ops-bot: ticket created CS-4307 assigned to Iris K, Samir D; calendar event created: "Asterion private cutover - Thu 07:30 PDT" invited: Zoe M, Priya R, Jordan L, Samir D, Iris K.
Iris K: One open item: we need the customer's IAM principal ARN (IAM user or role) to add to the CMK policy. Pinged their PM again.
Priya R: Action items summary: Jordan post route + bucket-policy diff (EOD Tue), Samir create CMK + run preflight (Wed 16:00), Iris finalize key policy + log forwarding option (Wed EOD), Zoe confirm CS attendance & feedback survey plan. We'll run a short retrospective 24h post-cutover and send a one-question feedback: "Was the cutover communication and execution satisfactory?"
Jordan L: No technical blockers from network; will add the cost delta in the PR.
Samir D: If preflight fails on KMS decrypt, fallback is to hold routes and rollback TGW attachment changes. I'll prepare rollback steps in the runbook.
Zoe M: I'll draft the feedback survey and coordinate a 10-min enablement session post-cutover for their ops team.
Priya R: Thanks everyone. If we get the IAM principal ARN and the bucket policy change in place, we should be green. :thumbsup:
